title: Einstein connection of nonsymmetric pseudo-Riemannian manifold
summary:
A.Einstein considered a linear connection $
abla$ with torsion $T$ on a smooth manifold equipped with a nonsymmetric (0,2)-tensor $G=g+F$, where $g$ is a pseudo-Riemannian metric associated with gravity, and $F
e0$ is a skew-symmetric tensor associated with electromagnetism, such that $(
abla_X\,G)(Y,Z)=-G(T(X,Y),Z)$.
